We can wonder about the order type of the canonical stratifications which
occur as output of the stratifications of type (a) constructed in
Lemma <REF_0001>.
A natural guess is that the well-ordered set <MATH_0001> has
<TEXTITOPEN_0001>cardinality<TEXTITCLOSE_0001> at most <MATH_0002>. We have no idea if this is true
or false. If you do please email
<TEXTOPEN_0001>stacks.project@gmail.com<TEXTCLOSE_0001>.
